items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free cleanser is a good base for morning use on skin that gets the odd spot.
A low-strength 2.5% wash used in the evening is a mild way to help keep the look of occasional spots down.
A light, mattifying moisturizer suits oily-looking skin and keeps the routine to one simple step.
A daily mineral SPF protects skin and helps keep the look of spot marks from deepening on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Morning: gentle cleanser, mattifying gel, then SPF; evening: benzoyl peroxide wash used every other night at first, then the mattifying gel. The wash can bleach towels and fabrics, so rinse well and use white towels.
